reviews.text: We had an amazing experience with our pool and spa installation! The team showed great attention to detail, care, and professionalism throughout the entire process. Nolan, Braden, Robert, and the rest of the crew were wonderful during the design and planning stages, always suggesting creative ideas and helping us design the perfect backyard oasis for our home in Arlington. They kept us updated every week about the project’s progress, which made everything smooth and easy to follow. During construction, Braden went above and beyond, answering all our questions, making sure each step was completed to a high standard, and checking in regularly to ensure we were happy with the results. The project manager also stopped by several times to oversee the work and make sure everything was on track. We are thrilled with our new pool and spa, and would definitely recommend this pool service company to anyone looking to transform their outdoor space!
reviews.author: Elizabeth Ryan

reviews.text: We recently had our pool in Arlington resurfaced and were truly impressed with the excellent service. Robert and his team were always on time, friendly, and very professional throughout the process. The quality of their pool work is top-notch, and you can tell they really care about the results. They made sure to keep our backyard tidy and cleaned up after each visit, which we really appreciated. If you’re looking for reliable pool service in Arlington, we highly recommend them for any job, big or small.
reviews.author: Lydia Lester

reviews.text: We had our pool built and have used their pool cleaning services ever since. Every time we need help with anything, they respond quickly and do a great job keeping our pool sparkling clean. When our pool was first built, they gave us helpful advice on the design and all the technical parts, making the whole process smooth and hassle-free. The team, especially John, always makes sure everything is done right and on time. We really appreciate how reliable and professional they are. If you need pool cleaning in Arlington, I highly recommend their services!
reviews.author: Alondra Terrell

reviews.text: After 20 years with our pool, we noticed some surface issues and decided it was time for a full cleaning and refresh. We had used a different pool company in the past for repairs, but weren't happy with how long it took to get help this time around. That’s when we searched for other local pool cleaning experts and got a few quotes. One of the local pool suppliers in Arlington suggested reaching out to Dalworthington Gardens Pool Service. After sending an online request, I got a quick response back and ended up working with Nolan. I sent over some photos of our pool, which had a few cracks, and shared the pool layout. Nolan was able to give us a rough estimate right away, and we quickly set up a time for an on-site inspection. Before work started, my spouse and I stopped by their office in Arlington and were impressed with how professional everything looked. Seeing the different pool finish samples in person made it easier to pick what we wanted. Nolan helped us choose the right tile, pebble finish, and other upgrades to make our pool stand out. Once the pool cleaning and remodeling started, everything moved along smoothly and quickly. Communication was always clear, and we felt updated at every step. Now our pool looks amazing, and we’re enjoying it every day in the Texas heat. We’re really happy we chose them for our pool cleaning and upgrade!
reviews.author: heidi reese

reviews.text: Dalworthington Gardens Pool Service did a full pool remodel for us, and even after all this time, our pool still looks fantastic. Their outstanding service has continued well beyond the remodel. Recently, we needed some routine pool maintenance for our salt water generator, and Braden came by quickly with a replacement part to get our pool chlorinator working again. The response time was impressive and made it easy to keep our pool sparkling clean. Highly recommend for anyone needing pool cleaning or repairs!
reviews.author: Kristie Blankenship

reviews.text: After spending more than 20 years searching for a reliable pool cleaning company, I finally found the right one. I had my previous pool service look at my pool heater when it stopped working, and they told me there was no hope and that I needed to buy a brand new heater. Before making that big decision, I wanted another opinion and ended up calling Dalworthington Gardens Pool Service by accident. I spoke with Robert, who asked if someone had referred me. When I said no, he mentioned that they specialize in pool heaters. Robert took a look at my heater and discovered that the last company just tossed some parts under the cover and left without fixing anything. Robert got it up and running by the following week, and my pool was back to being nice and warm—perfect for the Arlington heat. After the repair, I asked if they could also keep up with my salt water system, cleaning elements, and chemical balancing. Robert assured me that they handle everything, so I don’t have to worry about finding anything broken or dealing with maintenance issues. I just want to enjoy my pool and swim without hassle, and they keep me updated if anything needs attention. If there’s ever an emergency, I know they’ll take care of it right away. Ever since switching, I’ve been really happy with their pool cleaning and maintenance services. It’s been a relief to finally have a dependable company to take care of my pool in Arlington.
reviews.author: Julianna Burch

reviews.text: Dalworthington Gardens Pool Service was a fantastic choice for my backyard project in Arlington. I started looking for pool service companies because I wanted to upgrade my backyard with a new in-ground pool and some extra features. I had a few ideas, but was open to suggestions that would make the most of my space. After meeting with a few companies, I decided to go with Dalworthington Gardens Pool Service because they impressed me with their quick response, competitive pricing, and an outstanding pool design that really stood out—so much so that other companies even asked me about the design! While some other companies gave me long timelines and excuses, Braden from Dalworthington Gardens Pool Service was upfront about how long things would take, and actually finished the work even faster than promised. The project included installing a heated pool, adding an outdoor kitchen, and putting in turf and landscaping for my dogs. Throughout the process, the team kept in touch and sent me daily updates with photos, which made it easy to see the progress from start to finish. Geoffrey and the construction crew worked hard every day, always kept the area clean, and made sure my gates were closed so my dogs stayed safe. Their attention to detail and professionalism really made the difference. I couldn’t be happier with how everything turned out and highly recommend them to anyone in Arlington looking for pool construction, renovations, or backyard improvements.
reviews.author: grace downs

reviews.text: we got quotes from three pool cleaning companies in arlington, all of which were highly rated. everyone gave us quick and clear estimates for cleaning and maintaining our pool, answered our questions patiently, and acted really professional and friendly. what stood out about dalworthington gardens pool service was that they gave us a detailed info packet with pool care tips, a copy of their business license and insurance, references from other local customers, and even reviews and awards. we took our time deciding which company to go with for the pool cleaning and maintenance, but after meeting with robert at their office, seeing photos of sparkling clean pools they had serviced, and reviewing their cleaning products, we felt confident. robert really helped us feel comfortable with our choice. since we wanted the cleaning done before the hot texas summer, he promised to let us know as soon as a spot opened up. he called just like he said he would, and we picked a date. the week before our cleaning, robert called to confirm the time and made sure he knew exactly how we wanted everything handled. on the day of service, the team showed up right on time, introduced themselves, and explained the steps they'd take to get our pool sparkling. everyone worked hard and seemed to know exactly what to do. by the end of the day, our pool and deck were spotless, filters were changed, drains were cleared, and everything was left looking great. the team checked in to make sure we were happy with the work before they left, and the next day, robert called to follow up and see if we needed anything else. from start to finish, the whole experience was very smooth. the staff were polite, knowledgeable, and worked efficiently. our pool has never looked better, and we're really happy with the results.
reviews.author: tony jenkins

data.summary: Reviews appear highly authentic. They contain specific details, varied narratives, and mention staff by name. The single 3-4 star review is still positive. The clustering of dates is a minor concern but not definitive of fakery. No substantive complaints or red flags found.
fake_signals: Multiple reviews posted within a short timeframe (a month ago)
Some reviews have generic, incomplete endings

positive_evidence: Review mentions outstanding service continuing well beyond a remodel and a quick response for maintenance

authentic_signals: Specific project details (resurfacing, heater repair, salt water generator)
Mention of crew names (Robert, John, Braden, Nolan)
One review mentions a prior negative experience with another company, adding credibility
Detailed mention of provided materials (info packet, license, references)
